how_to_verify: For each artifact: curl -s https://svread.pages.dev/data/verify/tantraloka-a12-tal-a12-p02/<name> | sha256sum, then compare that hash with the same artifact's 'sha256' above and in the trace. If every artifact matches and the trace's recorded verdict/gaps agree with what you read, the chain is intact. A mismatch means the upstream bytes changed after the trace was made: treat the trace as stale, not the hash as wrong.
limits: Matching bytes prove the trace and these files agree. They do NOT prove the translation is correct, that a human reviewed it, or that a witness exists (witnesses are UNPINNED). Tiers: MODEL_CHECKED applies only to formal theorems inside their stated finite model.
